summary: Identity contract: baseline key is canonical identity hash of schema,inputfingerprint,selectedboard,kicadCLIpath/version/hash,pcbnewbuild,pourschema,grading-module/schema hashes. Same-key builders use disjoint generations; atomic current.json selects a complete generation, readers verify identity+allthree receipt hashes, malformed/legacy/incomplete entriesmiss, prior generations remain. Ledger attempt key is inputfingerprint+backend+normalizedsettings; execution fingerprint adds owned source/extension/Python/package hashes (orFreeroutingjar/Java), excluding unrelated repository commit while retaining readable provenance. Existing failed identical fingerprint refuses unless --force/ledgeroff; changedexecution permitsattempt; append is not exactly-once or executionlock. Repeat proof binds source/extension/package/Python/nativeCLI identity and snapshots selected generation under shared activationlock. Publication identity is nonsymlink destination+kind/schema+exact path/hash inventory; conflicting/unowned/changed/symlink casesrefuse, samekind intact inventory can atomically refresh. The malformed-root publication discrepancy is fixed only in primary and was independently tested; no narrower identity is treated as complete execution identity. Final f0f73da does not cache authoritative full identities. Only tool_env major selection is reused per attempt and invalidated by executable realpath/stat fingerprint. Full kicad-cli version/hash calls inside the same scope remain fresh, as directly asserted by new tests; baseline/ledger/repeat source and generation identity semantics remain unchanged.
